scenario_summary: 250-store omnichannel retailer runs its e-commerce and inventory platform on NexusPlatform. Six months into the 24-month contract, Meridian adds a Premium Analytics module at the standalone price — treated as a prospective new contract modification per ASC 606-10-25-12(a) because it adds distinct new services at their standalone selling price.

performance_obligations.name: E-Commerce & Inventory Platform
performance_obligations.description: 24-month access to NexusPlatform's omnichannel SaaS covering online storefront, in-store inventory management, order routing, and customer data platform for Meridian's 250 retail locations. Recognized straight-line over the 24-month term.

ssp.basis: $10,000/month standalone rate for Enterprise Omnichannel tier (201–500 stores)

payment_schedule._note: Year 1 fee invoiced on contract start

modifications.description: Meridian adds the Premium Analytics module — real-time basket analysis, store-level P&L dashboards, and demand forecasting powered by ML models. Priced at $5,000/month standalone, the same rate NexusPlatform charges all standalone analytics customers. Added for the remaining 18 months of the original term.
modifications._classification_rationale: Distinct new service (analytics module can be used independently of e-commerce functions; Meridian could purchase it from a third party) and priced at standalone selling price → separate contract per ASC 606-10-25-12(a). No reallocation of original contract.

new_performance_obligations.name: Premium Analytics Module
new_performance_obligations.description: Real-time sales analytics, store P&L dashboards, and ML-driven demand forecasting add-on. 6-month term (Jan–Jun 2026). Recognized straight-line.

additional_payment._note: Analytics module invoiced upfront on modification effective date
